# Key findings (generated by run_all.py)

- Scope: 96,203 delivered orders, Jan 2017 - Aug 2018. On-time delivery 93.2%; median lead time 10 days.
- Late deliveries hurt satisfaction: on-time orders average 4.28 stars; 4-7 days late averages 2.09, and 68% of those reviews are 1-2 stars (vs 9.5% when on time).
- Root cause: 72% of late orders were handed to the carrier on time by the seller and still arrived late, so transit is the bigger lever than seller handoff.
- Concentration: 98 sellers (3.3% of active sellers) account for 50% of late orders.
- Worst lane: SP -> RJ carries 8.4% of orders but 17.6% of late orders (14.1% late).
- Peak stress: on-time fell to 87.6% in Nov 2017 (Black Friday month) and 81.0% in Mar 2018.
- Freight: 22.7% of item price in the North and 21.7% in the Northeast, vs 15.2% in the Southeast.
- ABC-XYZ: 18 of 74 categories make up 81% of revenue; 8 of them have steady demand (X), 9 are variable (Y), 1 erratic (Z).
